title: helianthemum apenninum subsp. rothmaleri
intro: Helianthemum apenninum subsp. rothmaleri, commonly known as Apennine rockrose, is a plant species within the family Cistaceae. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in wound healing and the prevention of cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum apenninum subsp. rothmaleri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. Research has identified saponins, tannins, and other compounds as potential contributors to the plant's therapeutic effects.
